subject: Halcyon Health deployment: Sales → CS handoff & kickoff scheduling

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Handoff: Halcyon Health — final commercial & kickoff window

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Quick handoff for Halcyon Health (deal RWD-2026-1187). Signed SOW attached (SOW_Halcyon_v2_signed.pdf). Key context and asks below — please own kickoff scheduling and implementation tracking.

Deal summary (short):
- ARR: mid-six figures (annualized)
- Primary use: patient intake summarization and charting automation for triage workflows
- Initial scope: hosted API with dedicated throughput lanes; SSO + strict data retention policy
- Go-live target: mid-Jan 2027 (soft launch with 2 teams)

Must-haves / customer expectations:
1) SSO (SAML) integration with Okta — they need mapping of groups to roles.
2) Data residency: US regions only and retention 90 days, with options to extend.
3) Performance targets: p95 latency < 180ms for text gen requests at 8k context.
4) Support: 24x5 during ramp, named CSM required.

Risks / blockers I raised in the deal:
- Customer wants the dedicated pool reserved by 2026-12-15 to meet ramp commitments.
- Legal redline around data deletion clause is already accepted in SOW, but they may still request clarifying language in the onboarding doc.

Attachments included for reference: SOW_Halcyon_v2_signed.pdf; implementation_checklist_halcyon.xlsx

Next steps I need from CS:
- Marissa: take ownership and confirm kickoff times by EOD Monday 12/7.
- Karthik: quick pre-kickoff ops review on SSO and network requirements; any potential infra gaps flagged by 12/8.

I'll send a short intro to the customer (copying you) once you confirm owners.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

- Ownership: Marissa Cole (CSM) — I will be the named contact.
- Initial kickoff agenda: introductions, success criteria, access, SSO plan, data retention confirmation, P0 implementation milestones. I'll propose 60 minutes.

1) For the dedicated throughput, is there an initial QPS target we should build against or just the p95 latency requirement you mentioned?
2) Do we have any pre-approved SAML metadata or should we expect to collect them during kickoff?

Karthik — can you confirm if there are any known infra lead times for reserving the dedicated pool by 12/15? If so, flag here and I'll expedite scheduling.

I'll draft the kickoff invite and copy both of you plus Andrea (external) once I hear back on the two points.

—Marissa

Subject: Re: Handoff: Halcyon Health — final commercial & kickoff window (technical notes)

Adding a short technical note from infra/implementation perspective — copied into the thread so CS has visibility.

Notes / action items for implementation planning:
- Dedicated capacity: we can reserve a small pool now, but to guarantee p95 <180ms at 8k context we'll need to allocate an NVLink-backed instance class (lead time ~5 business days from provisioning ticket). Please confirm reserve by 12/10 latest.
- SSO: we support standard SAML with attribute mapping. Halcyon will need to provide IdP metadata and test accounts. Recommend pre-kickoff exchange of metadata + test account(s).
- Network / VPC: If they opt for Private deployment later, we'll need their network CIDR and firewall rules; for hosted dedicated we only require egress exceptions — I'll attach the network checklist.
- Data retention: 90-day retention configurable via tenant settings; confirm if they want auto-archival or manual deletion.

Documentation references attached: implementation_checklist_halcyon.xlsx (contains a short ticket and sequencing plan).

I'll coordinate with infra to provision the pool as soon as Marissa confirms the reservation date.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
